description: This Java interface defines a factory for creating command response objects, particularly error responses, for live commands within the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides methods to generate error responses based on exceptions and Thing identifiers, with some deprecated methods indicating evolution in how Thing IDs are handled.

classes.name: LiveCommandResponseFactory
classes.description: An interface serving as a factory for creating command response objects, mainly error responses, for commands in the Eclipse Ditto signals framework.

methods.name: errorResponse
methods.description: Creates a generic ErrorResponse containing the provided DittoRuntimeException.
